plan.logging: light timing capture; actual search subset at 1 Hz, no large input snapshots
plan.scope: fresh full REMANI+MPPI fixed-arm numerical ROS SIL; NOT Gazebo or hardware
plan.limitations: one seed per pair; tests combined changes online, not individual causal effects or success rates

measured_stops.definition: measured |v| < 0.01 m/s and |w| < 0.03 rad/s; left-sample intervals

validation.scope: sum of actual execution-validation call timers per solver cycle, including all retries; not callback minus kernel; thread CPU excludes other threads

mppi.scope: invoked solver cycles, including failures; update intervals use all consecutive actual command publications after goal; monotonic wall-clock milliseconds

loop.scope: cycle_start to sleep_enter, including publication/logging; excludes deliberate sleep and other Python/ROS threads

cpu.scope: process total CPU percent; 100% is one logical core; sampled mean/P95, filtered by monotonic command-publication interval; not optimizer-only CPU

remani.limitations: search includes A* / initial polynomial work, not pure graph-search CPU; request/frontend/backend overlap and must not be summed; all completed failures included

alignment.matched_by: solve timestamp, reason, validation code, ordered within duplicate keys; cycle publication controls cutoff

actual_reference_settings.actual_mppi_horizon: Native validity minus observation age and 10 ms reserve, rounded down to 0.1 s steps
actual_reference_settings.map_grid: Native 15 x 10 m grid unchanged; goal and whole fixed body remain inside its x upper limit of 7.5 m
actual_reference_settings.terminal_near_obstacle_cost: MPPI预测轨迹末端近障惩罚: not restored in this settings-only experiment
unchanged: latest-state rollout and fallback braking validation
actual_reference_settings.notes: Common 6m arena/speed/horizon; each scene comes from manifest.scenario. Only collision model differs within a pair.
actual_reference_settings.scope: One fixed-arm differential-drive native ROS numerical SIL run, NOT Gazebo/hardware

trials.collision_scope: own recorded sphere model versus finite walls/cylinders; different sphere geometry means these gaps are not a common mesh-level accuracy test
trials.scope: fixed-arm differential-drive full REMANI + MPPI online numerical ROS SIL; not Gazebo or hardware

delivery.timeout_semantics: force_stop=3 is solver budget exhaustion; success=true may still deliver a checked candidate

native_wall_accounting.window: first native blocked check to first later native reference publication
native_wall_accounting.interpretation: closed measured intervals only; wait keys can overlap; unattributed is not assumed CPU contention

delivery.limitations: native pass means backend candidate only; linked native publication and MPPI consumption counted separately; native_validation_ms covers every entered final native gate, failed and successful
